heron-standard-dialogue.npc: Hop inside my mouth if you want to live!

heron-standard-dialogue.player: I'm not falling for that... I'm not a fish! I've got more foresight than that.

heron-standard-dialogue-with-great-blue-.speaker: Note
heron-standard-dialogue-with-great-blue-.text: If the player has unlocked the great blue heron metamorphosis, there is a 10% chance to receive this dialogue instead of the one above.

heron-standard-dialogue-with-great-blue-.player: I think you may have a problem.

heron-standard-dialogue-with-great-blue-.npc: I agree, you don't give me anywhere enough of those. So get to it.

heron-using-items-on-it-less-than-3-000-.npc: Those look tasty. But I'm looking for a proper feast. Come back to me with 3000 of them.
Not really, I'm just a little bit peckish.

heron-using-items-on-it-less-than-3-000-.player: Good thing you have a beak then!

heron-using-items-on-it-raw-fish-with-gr.npc: No thanks. I'm craving a Spirit flake right now.

steps.npc: What's the big idea? If you're going to offer me a Spirit flake, at least have one to hand!

great-blue-heron-standard-dialogue.player: Haven't you already eaten enough Spirit flakes?

great-blue-heron-standard-dialogue.npc: Yes, I have. That's why I'm asking you for raw fish.

great-blue-heron-standard-dialogue.player: Sometimes I wonder whether getting stuck with you was my good luck or yours.

options.text: Yes, it could use a nice snack.

steps.text: In a remarkable display of gluttony, your pet Heron consumes 3000 Spirit flakes. It turns blue in front of your very eyes.

steps.npc: That really hit the spot! Though I feel a little blue now that there are none left.

options.text: No, I'm not shelling that out for a snack.

The Great blue heron turns back into a white Heron.

great-blue-heron-using-items-on-it-cooke.npc: Are you trying to annoy me?

great-blue-heron-using-items-on-it-cooke.player: I put in a lot of effort cooking this for you.

great-blue-heron-using-items-on-it-cooke.npc: Exactly, you've cooked it! You've ruined a fine delicacy, now go and uncook it!
I once knew a cat who mastered uncooking. Nice guy, actually. Enough talk, go and get me some more raw fish!

great-blue-heron-using-items-on-it-burnt.npc: And you think that I can do anything with something charred to the bone?

great-blue-heron-using-items-on-it-burnt.player: In my culture, these well-cooked fish are considered pretty valuable.

great-blue-heron-using-items-on-it-eel-s.npc: Sushi? Do I look like a commoner to you?

great-blue-heron-using-items-on-it-eel-s.player: In Dorgeshuun culture, this is considered a delicacy.

great-blue-heron-using-items-on-it-eel-s.npc: In bird culture, this is considered an insult. Get it out of my face at once!

great-blue-heron-using-items-on-it-eel-s.player: How could a member of my own house say something so horrible?
